Dangerous Goods

Сосуд под давлением

A container designed to hold gases or liquids at pressures substantially different from ambient pressure, regulated for transport under UN and IMDG codes.

Questions and answers

What is Сосуд под давлением?

In this glossary, Сосуд под давлением refers to: A container designed to hold gases or liquids at pressures substantially different from ambient pressure, regulated for transport under UN and IMDG codes.

How is Сосуд под давлением used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Сосуды под давлением должны быть сертифицированы и промаркированы в соответствии с соответствующими стандартами ООН до международной перевозки."

Definition

A container designed to hold gases or liquids at pressures substantially different from ambient pressure, regulated for transport under UN and IMDG codes.

Operational example

Pressure vessels must be certified and marked according to the relevant UN standards before international shipping.
